en.title: Oil Probability Plummets on Iran Deal Hopes
en.summary: The probability of WTI crude oil being up on May 22 plummeted by 54 percentage points to 2% in the last 24 hours. This sharp decline was primarily driven by strong market speculation and initial optimism surrounding a potential breakthrough in US-Iran peace talks, suggesting increased global oil supply.
drivers: Iran Deal Optimism: Strong market speculation of an imminent US-Iran peace deal increased supply expectations.
Potential Supply Surge: Anticipation of Iranian oil returning to market post-sanctions drove bearish price outlook.
Reduced Risk Premium: Hopes for de-escalation in US-Iran tensions lowered geopolitical risk premium on oil.
en.why_matters: US-Iran diplomatic progress directly impacts global oil supply and prices, affecting energy costs and geopolitical stability.
en.bull_case: Continued skepticism regarding a US-Iran deal will keep supply concerns high, pushing WTI prices higher.
en.bear_case: Renewed optimism for an imminent US-Iran deal could flood the market with oil, driving WTI prices significantly lower.

zh.title: 伊朗协议预期致油价概率暴跌
zh.summary: 5月22日WTI原油上涨的概率在过去24小时内暴跌54个百分点至2%。此次急剧下降主要受市场对美伊和平谈判可能取得突破的强烈猜测和初步乐观情绪驱动，预示全球原油供应将增加。
drivers: 伊朗协议乐观预期：市场强烈猜测美伊和平协议临近，增加了供应预期。
潜在供应激增：预期制裁解除后伊朗原油重返市场，导致看跌油价前景。
地缘风险溢价降低：对美伊紧张局势缓和的希望降低了原油的地缘政治风险溢价。
zh.why_matters: 美伊外交进展直接影响全球原油供应和价格，进而影响能源成本和地缘政治稳定。
zh.bull_case: 对美伊协议持续的怀疑将维持供应担忧，推动WTI油价走高。
zh.bear_case: 对美伊协议重新燃起的乐观情绪可能使市场充斥原油，导致WTI油价显著下跌。
